_meta_itemized.notes: Typed 2022 single_total sheet, 3 pages, county-letterhead printing (Clerk's Office / Coalville header on every page). ADDRESS COLUMN IS REDACTED BY THE COUNTY, NOT LEFT EMPTY BY THE FILER: the Mailing Address and Zip Code cells of the one donor row are white, but the printed GRID RULES THEMSELVES ARE BROKEN across exactly those two cells (the vertical rule between Mailing Address and Zip Code is gone in the donor row and the row above it, and the horizontal rules are interrupted mid-cell) - white-out applied over completed cells takes the ruling with it, whereas a filer who simply left the cells blank would leave the printed grid intact. Escalated at 900 dpi to establish this. donor_city/donor_state are therefore honestly BLANK. This matches the brief's note that Robinson's PRE-ELECTION copy is redacted while his Post-Election copy is not - the redaction is per-COPY, applied by the county to this scan, not something the filer did. A SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: the 2022 sheet is not one fixed printing - 19764's expense page prints a boxed 'Total amount of expenditures' and this filing's does not, so the presence of a section-total box cannot be assumed from the cycle; on this filing the cover figure is the ONLY arithmetic gate either side has. Geometry spot-verified end to end on both pages (p2 band 3 crops back to '2/28/2022 Christopher F. Robinson (self) ... $303.02', p3 band 13 to '2/28/2022 Summit County Clerk / Filing Fee for Summit County Council Seat "D" / $303.02'); note the measured band boxes on this filing are NARROW (about 9.4% of page width) because only two vertical rules survive detection on these pages - the band's vertical extent is correct and that is what indexes the row.
